policy_rules: Consultancy fees charged by RMP (Allopathy, Homeopathy, Physiotherapy, AYUSH) reimbursable up to reasonable actuals.
Medicines prescribed by RMP (Allopathy, Homeopathy, Physiotherapy, AYUSH) reimbursable up to reasonable actuals.
Medical tests prescribed by RMP (Allopathy, Homeopathy, Physiotherapy, AYUSH) reimbursable up to reasonable actuals.
Non-cosmetic dental treatments (dentures, cavity fillings, non-gold metal caps) prescribed by RMP covered up to reasonable actuals.
Vision-related expenses (spectacles/contact lens frames and glasses) capped at INR 10,000 per employee/eligible dependent per policy year.
Hearing aids recommended by RMP reimbursable up to reasonable actuals.
Pre-Natal outpatient care limit capped at INR 19,900 per dependent or employee per instance (up to 2 instances of childbirth). EDD certificate upload required to unlock benefit.
Fees for Online Teleconsultations are excluded.
Cosmetic treatments in any form are excluded.
Consultations with nutritionists and dieticians are excluded even if prescribed.
Health foods, dietary supplements, and naturopathy expenses are excluded even if prescribed.
Membership fees for health/well-being apps and gyms are excluded.
Home medical treatments (including peritoneal dialysis) are excluded.
Caregiver (nurse or otherwise) expenses are excluded.
Infertility treatment or management expenses are excluded.
Services availed outside policy period (01 April 2026 to 31 March 2027) are excluded.

policy.text:
Inclusions:?
The policy covers only non-hospitalization expenses defined below:
1 - Consultancy fee charged by a Registered Medical Practitioner [RMP] is eligible for reimbursement up to reasonable actuals. The scope covers for consultancy fee covered under allopathy, homeopathy, physiotherapy, and ayurvedic treatments under AYUSH.
2 - Expenses incurred on medicines as prescribed by a Registered Medical Practitioner [RMP], are claimable up to reasonable actuals. The scope covers for medicines prescribed under allopathy, homeopathy, physiotherapy, and ayurvedic treatments under AYUSH.
3 - Expenses related to medical tests, as prescribed by a Registered Medical Practitioner [RMP], are claimable up to reasonable actuals. The scope covers medical tests prescribed under allopathy, homeopathy, physiotherapy, and ayurvedic treatments under AYUSH.
4 - Dental expenses, covering non-cosmetic dental treatments such as dentures, cavity fillings, or the fitting of non-gold metal caps, as prescribed by an RMP, can be claimed up to reasonable actuals.
5 - Vision-related expenses, including the cost of spectacles/ contact lens [Frames and Glasses], are eligible for reimbursement, with a maximum limit of INR 10,000 per employee/eligible dependent member per policy year.
6 - Hearing aids recommended by a Registered Medical Practitioner are reimbursable up to reasonable actuals.

8 - Pre-Natal
Under Prenatal care, expecting females (employees or dependents) can avail a host of services defined below under outpatient care and purchase of prenatal vitamins. The overall of limit for outpatient care is capped at INR 19,900 per dependent or employee per instance (coverage up to 2 instances of childbirth). Kindly note that in order to unlock this benefit the employee will be asked to upload an EDD certificate (one time activity). EDD refers to an Expected Date of Delivery certificate which is issued by the treating doctor to the expecting female employee/dependent.
Outpatient care - Up to 10 prenatal outpatient care visits (includes physical exam BP, fundal height, fetal heart tones) - Include nutritional counseling with each visit. - Review personal risk factors such as smoking, alcohol, medications. - Include provisions for women with complex case-management needs. - Vitamin and iron supplements - Recommended vaccines
Testing
First trimester: - Baseline blood type and Rh - Complete Blood Count, - Pap smear - Urinalysis, - Screening for sexually transmitted diseases (such as syphilis, gonorrhea, and Chlamydia, Hepatitis B, HIV) - Genetic disorder screenings such as: (serum plasma protein screening, human chorionic gonadotropin, and alpha-fetoprotein) - Fetal ultrasound xl-2 (5 maximum total)
Second trimester: - Complete Blood count - Screening for gestational diabetes after 24 weeks with Glucose Tolerance Test. - Genetic disorder screenings such as: (serum plasma protein screening, human chorionic gonadotropin, alpha-fetoprotein, amniocentesis, and chorionic villus sampling) - Fetal Ultrasound xl-2 (5 maximum total)
Third Trimester: - Complete Blood Count - Group B Strep (depending on local guidelines and practices) - Fetal Ultrasound xl-2 (5 maximum total)
Prenatal Vitamins: - Folic Aid - Iron - Iron infusion (if necessary) - Calcium

Exclusions:
Any treatment covered under the Hospitalization category within the Group Medical Insurance policy is not within the scope of coverage for this policy.
Expenses rejected under the Hospitalization category within the Group Medical Insurance policy are not within the scope of coverage for this policy.
Fees, whether subscription-based or otherwise, paid for Online Teleconsultations with a Registered Medical Practitioner are excluded from the scope of coverage of this policy.
Any expense incurred for a treatment falling within the Partnership for Prevention scheme is excluded from the scope of coverage of this policy.
Expense incurred on cosmetic treatments in any form is excluded from the scope of coverage of this policy.
Expense incurred on consultation with nutritionists and dieticians, even when prescribed, are outside the scope of coverage of this policy.
Expense related to health foods, dietary supplements, and naturopathy, even when prescribed, is outside the scope of coverage of this policy.
Expense related to membership fees for health and well-being apps, gym memberships is outside the scope of coverage of this policy.
Expense for health, gym, or sports equipment, including but not limited to thermometers, BP apparatus, CPAP/Bi-PAP machines, is outside the scope of coverage of this policy.
Expense related to prenatal and antenatal is outside the scope of coverage of this policy.
Expenses related to vaccination (preventive or otherwise) are can not be claimed under another benefits other than vaccination benefit.
Expense incurred on weight management is outside the scope of coverage of this policy.
Expense incurred on ambulance charges is not covered within the scope of this policy.
Expenses incurred with medical treatments conducted at home (including but not limited to peritoneal dialysis) are not within the scope of coverage of this policy.
Expense incurred for Caregiver (Nurse or otherwise) is outside the scope of coverage of this policy.
Expenses related to the procurement of contraceptives are outside the scope of coverage of this policy.
Expenses related to the procurement of personal care items, including but not limited to soaps, face wash, moisturizers, lotions/creams, shampoos, hair lotions, and procedures like peeling, are not covered by this policy.
Expenses related to the procurement of services or products, including but not limited to hair treatment (growth), protein powder, and baby food bills, are not covered under this policy.
19. Consumables are not covered udner the policy coverage ( Ex: Disposable & Routine Consumables, Injection & Infusion Related Consumables, Dressing & Wound Care Materials, Personal Comfort & Hygiene Items, Miscellaneous (Non-Medical / Daily-Use Items).
20. Services availed outside the policy period are not covered.(Policy Period: 01 April 2026 to 31 March 2027).
21. Expense incurred on infertility treatment or management is outside the scope of coverage of this policy.
